items.title: SharkNinja set for S&P 500 entry in wave of deal-driven index changes
items.summary: Investing.com -- Sharkninja Inc (NYSE:SN) is set to join the benchmark S&P 500 next week as part of a broader index reshuffle triggered by pending corporate acquisitions.
